services.name: Camp
services.desc: As school tapers off, we are excited to provide a fun and physical activity during the summer season. Focus Summer Camps are filled with fun climbing activities, both on and off the wall, and are designed with keeping your child learning and active. Summer Camps at Focus are limited in size (12 kids maximum), and guarantee more individual time with our professional instructors. Don’t pay big money for group babysitting.
